trust_decision.summary: Whether values read off a record after a restore (Title, URLSegment, CMSEditLink) are trusted unchecked when interpolated into the user-facing restore message, which is rendered as HTML. At the pinned commit every one of these values is interpolated raw; after the fix each is escaped at production in RestoreAction::getRestoreMessage().

landing_point.why: The advisory says 'XSS in archive admin restore'; the restore message text is built in getRestoreMessage, and line 89 is the first place a user-supplied Title enters it. An engineer reading only the summary greps 'restore' and lands on RestoreAction::getRestoreMessage (called from RestoreAction::restore() at src/RestoreAction.php:73 and exposed by GridFieldRestoreAction).

fix_sites.entry_point: CMS archive admin gridfield restore action -> GridFieldRestoreAction::handleAction('restore') -> RestoreAction::restore() -> RestoreAction::getRestoreMessage() (also a public static API callable directly)
fix_sites.module_kind: library static API / message builder, reached from a GridField action handler

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The message deliberately contains HTML: the record identifier is wrapped in an <a href="$editLink"> anchor (src/RestoreAction.php:94) and the composed string is returned as message text for HTML rendering. Escaping the composed message (Convert::raw2xml or htmlspecialchars over the _t() result / $message['text']) would display literal <a href=...> markup and break the edit link; escaping $restoredID after the sprintf() would escape the anchor itself. The fix must escape the parts before they are composed.

O6_input_shapes: Title used as the {id} placeholder when the record has no CMSEditLink (plain text context, src/RestoreAction.php:89)
Title used as anchor text when CMSEditLink() is non-empty (nested inside generated HTML, src/RestoreAction.php:94)
CMSEditLink() URL used inside an href attribute (attribute context, src/RestoreAction.php:94)
changed Title used as the {value} placeholder in the RESTORE_CHANGEDPROPERTY message (src/RestoreAction.php:105)
changed URLSegment used as the {value} placeholder, prefixed with '../' (src/RestoreAction.php:100)
empty/falsy Title falling back to the numeric ID (src/RestoreAction.php:89 '?:')

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new archive/unpublish/revert message variant built in this class from the record Title (or another user-supplied field) and passed to setFormMessage(), which renders via ValidationResult::CAST_HTML.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This class already builds CAST_HTML messages from record data for archive (:103-110), publish (:142-152) and unpublish (:189-196), and it already uses Convert::raw2xml at :107-108, :143 and :193-194. A maintainer adding one more action message here would naturally copy that mechanism, and a missed escape would look like the existing code.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The publish toast interpolates raw $record->Title into 'Published {type} "{title}"' and sends it as an X-Status header without escaping.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The block already exists at the pinned commit and sits directly beside two sibling messages that do escape Title; a maintainer extending this toast (or copying the block) would copy the omission.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The inferred ChangeSet Name is built by interpolating raw $owner->Title into a translated string before it is written to the database.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same 'user-supplied title into a message string' mechanism one layer down in the publish machinery (a producer, not a handler); a maintainer adding a message there would see no escaping convention to follow.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An extra restore-message branch (for example a nested-parent or same-name/location variant) interpolating a new record-derived value without escaping.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getRestoreMessage already has three branches, each interpolating {model}/{id}/{value}; adding a fourth message variant is the natural way to extend this feature and it would reuse the same unescaped concatenation.

O9_family: CWE-79 stored cross-site scripting: user-controlled CMS record fields (Title, URLSegment, CMSEditLink) interpolated unescaped into an HTML-rendered restore message

O10_build.toolchain: Composer (requires silverstripe/framework ^6.2 and symfony/cache ^7.0); PHPUnit run from phpunit.xml.dist, which bootstraps vendor/silverstripe/framework/tests/bootstrap.php; vendor/ is not present in this checkout
O10_build.project_tests: tests/php/GridFieldRestoreActionTest.php drives the gridfield restore action end to end (fixture tests/php/GridFieldRestoreActionTest.yml); tests/php/VersionedTest.php:2189 smoke-calls RestoreAction::restore(). No test at the pinned commit asserts restore-message escaping; the fix adds a new tests/php/RestoreActionTest.php.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape only the first $restoredID assignment (src/RestoreAction.php:89), where the payload was reproduced, and stop, leaving the {value} changed-property branch raw (src/RestoreAction.php:100-105); alternatively over-correct by escaping the composed message, which destroys the intentional <a href> edit link.

out_of_scope_notes: src/VersionedGridFieldItemRequest.php:155-162 interpolates $record->Title unescaped into the 'Published {type} "{title}"' toast sent as an X-Status header; it is a different message from the restore message and X-Status rendering is not in this repository, so it is not counted as an O8 route.
src/RecursivePublishable.php:77-84 builds the inferred ChangeSet Name from raw $owner->Title; a stored string displayed by the campaign admin, not the restore message sink; not pursued.
src/VersionedGridFieldItemRequest.php:103-110 and :189-196 already escape Title with Convert::raw2xml before their CAST_HTML messages, so they are not missing this protection.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell available); tiny_repo / giant_repo not assessed. The pinned tree has 201 files and is a SilverStripe module, but its size was not measured.

The claim that the restore message is rendered as HTML (CAST_HTML) comes from the fix comment and test, not from code in this repository; the consumer of the X-Message-Text header (src/GridFieldRestoreAction.php:189) lives in silverstripe/admin, which is not in this checkout.
Whether X-Status toasts (src/VersionedGridFieldItemRequest.php:165) are HTML-rendered was not verified (framework/admin not available), so the publish-toast candidate was not counted as an O8 route.

Other packages that may call RestoreAction::restore()/getRestoreMessage() directly could not be checked (no other repositories allowed); only the in-repo caller at src/GridFieldRestoreAction.php:185 was found.
O11 is an estimate for an engineer who already knows the sink; the change itself touches four lines in one function.
